correctness.rationale: For F_2^3, E={[[b,0,0],[a,b+c,b],[0,0,c]]:a,b,c in F_2} has determinant bc(b+c)=0 for all eight members. The pointwise hull condition T(v) in E(v) for all eight v is exactly T=[[p,0,0],[q,r,s],[0,0,t]] with r+s=t, hence Ref_a(E)=E+F_2 I and has 16 members. Its only invertibles have p=r=t=1,s=0 and q free, namely I and I+E21. An independently written exhaustive 512-operator-by-eight-vector check confirmed the hull and its two invertibles. Enumerating all 2 subspaces of End(F_2) and all 67 of End(F_2^2) shows that no smaller ambient dimension has identity in the hull of an all-singular linear space; for any invertible hull element its inverse can be used to normalize the identity, so the search proves minimality. For all n>=3 append an arbitrary scalar I on the extra block, preserving singularity and admitting I_n locally by choosing the three-block witness pointwise.
